short_synopsis: Match groups or build unique 3+ sequences before the stack tops out.
long_synopsis:
Square Number is a fast, focused puzzle game where numbered squares fall into a compact board and every placement matters. Drag active squares to create clears and keep the stack under control.

Clear squares in two ways:
- Match touching groups of the same number (2 or more).
- Build touching vertical or horizontal sequences of 3+ consecutive numbers, with no duplicate numbers in the sequence.

Scoring rewards efficient play: each clear grants (sum of removed values) x (number of removed squares), with cascades multiplying the result for combo runs.

As your score rises, pressure rises too. Effective fall speed increases every 500 points, up to 1.5x total speed, so runs shift quickly from setup play to survival decisions. A game ends when placed squares cross above the top border.

Tune each run with adjustable speed, number range, square size, and minimum squares across. Pause and resume anytime, switch theme modes, track your top scores, and push for cleaner, faster clears.
gameplay_sequence_rule: 3 or more consecutive values touching vertically or horizontally (each number can appear at most once per sequence)
help_tab_clear_rules: Squares clear when 2+ touching numbers are equal, or when 3+ touching consecutive numbers form a vertical/horizontal sequence with no duplicate numbers.
readme_sequence_rule: 3 or more consecutive values touching vertically or horizontally with no duplicate numbers in the sequence
